# docker_network

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: resource. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

A Docker network (`NetworkCreate`): a local `bridge`/`macvlan`/`ipvlan` network, or a Swarm-scoped `overlay` network when the daemon is a Swarm manager. Docker networks cannot be changed after creation, so every argument forces a new network. Import by network name or ID.

### `ipam_config`

list of blocks. Static IPAM pools. Without this block the daemon assigns a subnet itself (not reported in state). Forces replacement when a configured value differs from the network's: a missing block, or an argument left unset in a pool, accepts what the network already has (e.g. the daemon-assigned pool a kreuzwerker/docker state records) and only drops it from state.

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aux_address` | `map(string)` | optional |  |  | Auxiliary addresses the IPAM driver must not hand out, name to IP. |
| `gateway` | `string` | optional |  |  | Gateway address. Unset lets the daemon pick (not reported). |
| `ip_range` | `string` | optional |  |  | Sub-range to allocate container IPs from. |
| `subnet` | `string` | optional |  |  | Subnet in CIDR form, e.g. `10.20.0.0/24`. |

## Example

```terraform
# A user-defined bridge network with a static subnet.
resource "docker_network" "app" {
  name   = "app"
  labels = { team = "web" }

  ipam_config {
    subnet  = "10.20.0.0/24"
    gateway = "10.20.0.1"
  }
}

# A Swarm overlay network standalone containers may also join
# (requires the daemon to be a Swarm manager).
resource "docker_network" "mesh" {
  name       = "mesh"
  driver     = "overlay"
  attachable = true
}

# A swarm-scoped macvlan network: each node holds a config-only network with
# its local parent interface and subnet, and the swarm network takes its
# configuration from it (docker network create --config-only / --config-from).
resource "docker_network" "macvlan_config" {
  name        = "macvlan-config"
  driver      = "macvlan"
  config_only = true
  options     = { parent = "eth0" }

  ipam_config {
    subnet = "192.168.50.0/24"
  }
}

resource "docker_network" "macvlan" {
  name        = "macvlan"
  driver      = "macvlan"
  scope       = "swarm"
  config_from = docker_network.macvlan_config.name
}
```

## Import

```shell
# Import by network name or ID.
terraform import docker_network.app app
```
